mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.label, i.position, i.checked, i.checked_by_user_id, u.display_name AS checked_by_display_name, i.checked_at FROM task_checklist_items i LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = i.checked_by_user_id WHERE i.task_id = #{taskId} AND i.space_id = #{spaceId} AND i.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY i.position, i.id
